description:
Browse and pin to your self-hosted Pinry server An unofficial Android app for Pinry, the self-hosted Pinterest alternative. You need your own Pinry server (2.x) to use it. Browse
  • Masonry feed with infinite scroll and pull to refresh
  • Feeds per tag, user and board
  • Full-screen image viewer with pinch and double-tap zoom; swipe through the feed
  • Search tags and boards
Pin from anywhere
  • From your gallery, from a URL, or from any app with Android's share sheet
  • Links to web pages use the page's preview image
  • HEIC and rotated phone photos are fixed before upload
  • Tags with autocomplete, private pins, straight into a board
Organise
  • Edit and delete your pins
  • Create, rename, hide and delete boards; save pins to them or remove them
  • Download pictures to your phone, or share them to other apps
  • Long-press any pin to save, download or share it
Made to look good
  • Material 3 Expressive design
  • Colors from your wallpaper, a swatch or any hue; nine palette styles
  • Light, dark and pure black themes; three grid sizes
  • Each pin's screen takes its colors from the image
Browse public servers without an account, or log in to private ones; plain http on your home network works too. No analytics, no ads, no crash reporting: the app only talks to your server and to pages you pin from, unless you turn on Gravatar avatars in Settings.
